name: yolov8n_cat_emotion_v5_camsim
architecture_note: YOLOv8n (SiLU) trained with board-camera simulation augmentation (4:3 squash, blur, washed-out low contrast, JPEG) and hard-negative suppression on background / human-face negatives. Transpose-free NHWC detection head for 100% Ethos-U55 NPU mapping with Vela 3.9.0.
new_in_v5: human-face negatives: 150 face photos labeled as no-cat (train 120 x2, val 15, test 15) to stop people being detected as cats
transpose-free export head, 100% NPU with Vela 3.9.0

dataset.negatives: background + human faces (empty labels), test: 40 background + 15 faces
dataset.labeling: auto bounding boxes from COCO YOLOv8x (cat class), emotion from folder name; images stretched to square like the board

training_protocol.stage_1_optimizer: SGD, cosine lr 0.01 -> 0.001, close_mosaic 35, batch 64, imgsz 192
training_protocol.stage_2_optimizer: SGD lr0 0.0003, no mosaic, box 7.5 / cls 1.5 / dfl 1.5
training_protocol.loss_type: Hard-negative suppression (~fg_mask, thresh 0.20, weight 1.0) + emotion mutual-exclusion penalty + TaskAlignedAssigner (alpha 0.6, beta 4.5)
training_protocol.augmentation: camera simulation: horizontal squash 0.70-1.00, gaussian/motion blur, downscale, washed-out low contrast, desaturation, noise, JPEG q30-85

model.output_0_content: boxes cx, cy, w, h normalized 0-1

firmware_compatibility.himax_official_tflm_yolov8_od: verified on board (boxes + emotions over USB)
firmware_compatibility.project_esp32_firmware_output_img: not yet verified on board; its source expects pixel boxes (0-192) while this model outputs normalized 0-1 boxes
